name: Identifying an Ongoing Spell

text: You can try to identify a non-instantaneous spell by its observable effects if its duration is ongoing. To identify it, you must take the Study action and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check.

effects.name: Identify an ongoing spell
effects.note: Study action; the spell must be non-instantaneous with an ongoing duration and observable effects.
